# Decision catalog (auto-generated)

Read first. Then either grep for the matching annotation
(`@concept:` / `@story:` / `@decision:`) in the code under review, or read
`decisions/<slug>.md` for the full body. Generated by
`.ok-planner/bin/catalog-toc` and regenerated whenever a corpus delta
touches this collection. Do not edit by hand — changes will be
overwritten.
